answer: Problem: clone farms mint many keys and paste one grant tale to raid a shared grove. Mechanism: lock 2.15 POA in a personal vault for 13 hours and post a 44-byte yarrow tag (SHA-256 of clock-jitter||32-packet delay sketch||salt). Two live 10-byte echo probes, 5 hours apart, must be signed in 14s and bound to that vault; peers drop sketches under 18-bit distance. Cost: 2.15 POA, 13-hour lock, two unbatchable probes. Verify: unique yarrow tag, two timely signatures, sketch distance. Failure: reused tag, sketch collision, or late sign burns 68% and freezes that tag for seven epochs.
